$comment: Spark variant: Kimi K2.6 (:nitro throughput-optimized) manager pinned to Fireworks on OpenRouter.
Provider pinning is enforced at runtime via SPARK_OPENROUTER_PROVIDER_ONLY=fireworks
(see openrouter-manager.ts buildProviderPreference). The :nitro suffix on the model id
is OpenRouter's hint to pick the fastest available provider — the explicit pin makes
the routing deterministic and gives us a clean cost+TPS comparison vs grok-4.3.
